65:                     raise ValueError("MPFB is not compatible with mhskel files")

68:                     raise ValueError("Attempting to load a sub-rig without a parent")

70:                 rig.rig_header = json_data
71:                 rig.rig_definition = json_data["bones"]
72: 
73:             else:
74:                 rig.rig_header["version"] = 100

86:             if scale_factor:
87:                 rig.relative_scale = scale_factor / rig.rig_header["scale_factor"]
88: 
89:         rig.build_basemesh_position_info()

214:     def create_armature_and_fit_to_basemesh(self, for_developer: bool=False, add_modifier: bool=True) -> bpy.types.Object:
215:         """Use the information in the object to construct an armature and adjust it to fit the base mesh."""
216: 
217:         if self.parent:
218:             # Disable pose evaluation for parent so that any child-of constraints bind to rest pose.
219:             parent_armature = typing.cast(bpy.types.Object, self.parent.armature_object)
220:             typing.cast(bpy.types.Armature, parent_armature.data).pose_position = "REST"
221: 
222:         bpy.ops.object.armature_add(location=self.basemesh.location)
223:         armature_object = self.armature_object = typing.cast(bpy.types.Object, bpy.context.object)
224: 
225:         scale_factor = GeneralObjectProperties.get_value("scale_factor", entity_reference=self.basemesh)
226:         GeneralObjectProperties.set_value("scale_factor", scale_factor, entity_reference=armature_object)
227: 
228:         object_type = "Subrig" if self.parent else "Skeleton"
229: 
230:         GeneralObjectProperties.set_value("object_type", object_type, entity_reference=armature_object)
231: 
232:         armature_data = typing.cast(bpy.types.Armature, armature_object.data)
233:         armature_object.show_in_front = True
234:         armature_data.display_type = 'WIRE'
235: 
236:         bpy.ops.object.mode_set(mode='EDIT', toggle=False)
237: 
238:         for bone in armature_data.edit_bones:
239:             armature_data.edit_bones.remove(bone)
240: 
241:         bpy.ops.object.mode_set(mode='OBJECT', toggle=False)  # To commit removal of bones
242: 
243:         self.create_bone_collections()
244:         self.create_bones()
245:         self.update_edit_bone_metadata()
246:         self.rigify_metadata()
247: 
248:         if for_developer:
249:             self.save_strategies()
250: 
251:         RigService.set_extra_bones(armature_object, self.rig_header.get("extra_bones"))
252: 
253:         if self.rig_header.get("rigify_ui"):
254:             from .rigging.rigifyhelpers.rigifyhelpers import RigifyHelpers
255:             RigifyHelpers.load_rigify_ui(armature_object, self.rig_header["rigify_ui"])
256: 
257:         bpy.ops.object.mode_set(mode='OBJECT', toggle=False)
258: 
259:         if self.parent:
260:             parent_armature = typing.cast(bpy.types.Object, self.parent.armature_object)

272:     def get_best_location_from_strategy(self, head_or_tail_info: dict, use_default: bool=True) -> list[float] | None:
273:         strategy = head_or_tail_info["strategy"]
274:         location = None
275:         try:
276:             if strategy == "CUBE":
277:                 name = head_or_tail_info["cube_name"]
278:                 location = self.position_info["cubes"].get(name, None)
279:             elif strategy == "VERTEX":
280:                 index = head_or_tail_info["vertex_index"]
281:                 location = self.position_info["vertices"][index]
282:             elif strategy == "MEAN":
283:                 indices = head_or_tail_info["vertex_indices"]
284:                 if len(indices) > 0:
285:                     vertices = [self.position_info["vertices"][i] for i in indices]
286:                     location = [sum(v[i] for v in vertices) / len(vertices) for i in range(3)]
287:             elif strategy == "XYZ":
288:                 # Special strategy for Rigify heel marker.
289:                 # Uses different vertices for each coordinate channel.
290:                 indices = head_or_tail_info["vertex_indices"]
291:                 if len(indices) >= 3:
292:                     vertices = [self.position_info["vertices"][i] for i in indices]
293:                     location = [vertices[i][i] for i in range(3)]
294:         except IndexError:
295:             pass
296:         if location is not None and "offset" in head_or_tail_info:
297:             location = [a + b * self.relative_scale for a, b in zip(location, head_or_tail_info["offset"])]
298:         if location is None and use_default:
299:             location = head_or_tail_info["default_position"]
300:         return location

302:     def _align_roll_by_strategy(self, bone: bpy.types.EditBone, bone_info: dict) -> None:
303:         """Aligns the roll of a bone based on the given strategy"""
304:         roll_strategy = bone_info.get("roll_strategy")
305:         roll_reference_z = None
306: 
307:         if roll_strategy == "ALIGN_Z_REFERENCE_Z":
308:             roll_reference_z = bone_info.get("roll_reference_z", bone.z_axis)
309: 
310:             # Ensure the type is list
311:             try:
312:                 roll_reference_z = list(roll_reference_z)
313:             except TypeError:
314:                 roll_reference_z = None
315: 
316:             bone_info["roll_reference_z"] = roll_reference_z
317: 
318:         if roll_strategy:
319:             self.apply_bone_roll_strategy(bone, roll_strategy, roll_reference_z )

321:     @staticmethod
322:     def apply_bone_roll_strategy(bone: bpy.types.EditBone, roll_strategy: str, roll_reference_z: list[float] | None = None) -> None:
323:         matrix = None
324: 
325:         if roll_strategy == "ALIGN_Z_WORLD_Z":
326:             matrix = matrix_from_axis_pair(bone.y_axis, (0, 0, 1), 'z')
327:         elif roll_strategy == "ALIGN_X_WORLD_X":
328:             matrix = matrix_from_axis_pair(bone.y_axis, (1, 0, 0), 'x')
329:         elif (
330:             roll_strategy == "ALIGN_Z_REFERENCE_Z"
331:             and roll_reference_z is not None
332:             and isinstance(roll_reference_z, (list, tuple))
333:             and len(roll_reference_z) == 3
334:         ):
335:             ref = Vector(roll_reference_z)
336:             if ref.length > 1e-6:
337:                 ref.normalize()
338:                 bone.align_roll(ref)
339: 
340:         if matrix:
341:             bone.roll = bpy.types.Bone.AxisRollFromMatrix(matrix, axis=bone.y_axis)[1]

343:     def create_bone_collections(self) -> None:
344:         armature_object = typing.cast(bpy.types.Object, self.armature_object)
345:         collections = typing.cast(bpy.types.Armature, armature_object.data).collections
346: 
347:         if bcoll_names := self.rig_header.get("collections"):
348:             for bcoll in list(collections):
349:                 collections.remove(bcoll)
350: 
351:             for name in bcoll_names:
352:                 collections.new(name)
353: 
354:         collections.active_index = 0

356:     def create_bones(self) -> None:
357:         """Create the actual bones in the armature object."""
358:         armature_object = typing.cast(bpy.types.Object, self.armature_object)
359:         bpy.ops.object.mode_set(mode='EDIT', toggle=False)
360:         bones = typing.cast(bpy.types.Armature, armature_object.data).edit_bones
361:         for bone_name in self.rig_definition.keys():
362:             bone_info = self.rig_definition[bone_name]
363:             bone = bones.new(bone_name)
364:             bone.roll = bone_info["roll"]
365:             bone.head = typing.cast(list[float], self.get_best_location_from_strategy(bone_info["head"]))
366:             bone.tail = typing.cast(list[float], self.get_best_location_from_strategy(bone_info["tail"]))
367: 
368:         # Apply roll strategies after head-tail positions have been set
369:         for bone_name in self.rig_definition.keys():
370:             bone_info = self.rig_definition[bone_name]
371:             bone = RigService.find_edit_bone_by_name(bone_name, armature_object)
372:             self._align_roll_by_strategy(bone, bone_info)
373: 
374:         bpy.ops.object.mode_set(mode='OBJECT', toggle=False)

864:     def build_basemesh_position_info(self, take_shape_keys_into_account: bool=True) -> None:
865:         """Populate the position information hash with positions from the base mesh.
866:         We will here also extract and store vertex positions and store them in the hash,
867:         as these positions may be influenced by shape keys."""
868: 
869:         self.position_info = dict()
870: 
871:         self.position_info["cubes"] = dict()
872:         cubes = self.position_info["cubes"]
873: 
874:         self.position_info["vertices"] = []
875:         vertices = self.position_info["vertices"]
876: 
877:         cube_groups = dict()
878:         group_index_to_name = dict()
879: 
880:         basemesh: bpy.types.Object = self.basemesh
881: 
882:         if not isinstance(basemesh.data, bpy.types.Mesh):
883:             raise TypeError(f"basemesh.data must be a Mesh, got {type(basemesh.data).__name__}")
884:         mesh = typing.cast(bpy.types.Mesh, basemesh.data)
885: 
886:         if self.parent:
887:             # Copy cube data from the parent rig if present
888:             cubes.update(self.parent.position_info["cubes"])
889:         else:
890:             # Start computing our own cube data
891:             for group in basemesh.vertex_groups:
892:                 idx = int(group.index)
893:                 name = str(group.name)
894:                 if "joint" in name:
895:                     cube_groups[name] = []
896:                     group_index_to_name[idx] = name
897: 
898:         coords = mesh.vertices
899:         shape_key = None
900:         key_name = None
901: 
902:         if take_shape_keys_into_account and mesh.shape_keys and mesh.shape_keys.key_blocks and len(mesh.shape_keys.key_blocks) > 0:
903:             if basemesh.mode == "EDIT":
904:                 if not basemesh.use_shape_key_edit_mode or basemesh.show_only_shape_key:
905:                     basemesh.use_shape_key_edit_mode = True
906:                     basemesh.show_only_shape_key = False
907:                     bpy.context.view_layer.update()
908: 
909:                 bm = bmesh.from_edit_mesh(mesh)
910:                 coords = bm.verts
911:             else:
912:                 from ..services import TargetService
913:                 key_name = "temporary_fit_rig_key." + str(secrets.randbelow(9000) + 1000)
914:                 shape_key = TargetService.create_shape_key(basemesh, key_name, also_create_basis=True, create_from_mix=True)
915:                 coords = shape_key.data
916: 
917:         for vertex in mesh.vertices:
918:             vertex_coords = list(typing.cast(typing.Iterable[float], coords[vertex.index].co))  # Either actual vertex or the corresponding shape key point
919:             vertices.append(vertex_coords)
920:             for group in vertex.groups:
921:                 idx = int(group.group)
922:                 if idx in group_index_to_name:
923:                     name = group_index_to_name[idx]
924:                     cube_groups[name].append(vertex_coords)
925: 
926:         if shape_key:
927:             basemesh.shape_key_remove(shape_key)
928: 
929:         _LOG.dump("cube_groups", cube_groups)
930: 
931:         for name in group_index_to_name.values():
932:             group = cube_groups[name]
933:             sum_pos = [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]
934:             for i in range(len(group)):
935:                 for n in range(3):
936:                     sum_pos[n] = sum_pos[n] + group[i][n]
937:             for n in range(3):
938:                 sum_pos[n] = sum_pos[n] / float(len(group))
939:             cubes[name] = sum_pos
